options.name: apply_time
options.description: Apply time of the I(network_attributes) and I(oem_network_attributes). This is applicable only to I(network_attributes) and I(oem_network_attributes). C(Immediate) allows the user to immediately reboot the host and apply the changes. I(job_wait) is applicable. This is applicable for I(oem_network_attributes) and I(job_wait). C(OnReset) allows the user to apply the changes on the next reboot of the host server. C(AtMaintenanceWindowStart) allows the user to apply at the start of a maintenance win

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: clear_pending
options.description: This parameter allows you to clear all the pending OEM network attributes changes. C(false) does not perform any operation. C(true) discards any pending changes to network attributes, or if a job is in scheduled state, removes the job. I(apply_time) value will be ignored and will not have any impact for I(clear_pending) operation. This operation is not supported for iDRAC8.

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: job_wait
options.description: Provides the option to wait for job completion. This is applicable when I(apply_time) is C(Immediate) for I(oem_network_attributes).

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. The job is tracked only for this duration. This option is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: This option allows you to schedule the maintenance window. This is required when I(apply_time) is C(AtMaintenanceWindowStart) or C(InMaintenanceWindowOnReset).

options.name: network_adapter_id
options.description: FQDD of the network adapter device that represents the physical network adapter capable of connecting to a computer network. An example of FQDD of the network adapter is 'NIC.Mezzanine.1A'

options.name: network_attributes
options.description: Dictionary of network attributes and value. To view the list of attributes and its structure, see the below API U(https://I(idrac_ip)/redfish/v1/Systems/System.Embedded.1/NetworkAdapters/<network_adapter_id>/NetworkDeviceFunctions/ <network_device_function_id>/Settings) and U(https://<idrac_ip>/redfish/v1/Schemas/NetworkDeviceFunction.v1_8_0.json). I(network_attributes) is mutually exclusive with I(oem_network_attributes).

options.name: network_device_function_id
options.description: FQDD of the network adapter device function that represents a logical interface exposed by the network adapter. An example of FQDD of the network adapter device function is 'NIC.Mezzanine.1A-1-1'

options.name: oem_network_attributes
options.description: The attributes must be part of the Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller Attribute Registry. To view the list of attributes in Attribute Registry for iDRAC9 and newer versions. For more information, see, U(https://I(idrac_ip)/redfish/v1/Chassis/System.Embedded.1/NetworkAdapters/<network_adapter_id>/NetworkDeviceFunctions/ <network_device_function_id>/Oem/Dell/DellNetworkAttributes/<network_device_function_id>) and U(https://I(idrac_ip)/redfish/v1/Registries/NetworkAttributesRegistry_<network_

options.name: resource_id
options.description: Id of the resource. If the value for resource ID is not provided, the module picks the first resource ID available from the list of system resources returned by the iDRAC.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
